notes.title: Version 1.1.7 now available
notes.notes:
A small patch which fixes some of the issues caused by the previous patch:
[list]
[*]Fixed bug which was causing some non-360 controllers to not receive certain axis inputs.
[*]Fixed broken shift key.
[*]Added controller compatibility options to handle multiple axis for DirectInput controllers.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.6 now available
notes.notes:
The following changes are in this patch:
[list]
    [*]Escape button no longer exits the game immediately. It instead brings up the pause menu in game and acts as a back button in the front end menu.
    [*]Display options can now be saved.
    [*]Increased screen scaling: Rotated screens in highest resolution settings should now be able to expand the display area further.
    [*]The game should now properly detect additional controller sources.
    [*]The game now detects additional axis movements. This should solve some of the control issues with certain joystick/controllers.
[/list]

Please note that I could not extensively test the controller fixes as I only have a limited amount of devices available. Please let me know if there are still any issues and I'll look into it ASAP!

notes.title: Upcoming patch
notes.notes:
Currently in the process of putting together a patch that will fix some of the issues that players have been reporting:

- Updated behaviour for the ESC button
- Certain controller joystick not picking up input
- Not recognizing controllers in certain conditions
- Saving resolution/fullscreen options
- Button behaviour in the continue screen

Thank you for supporting the game and hope to have this patch ready for everyone soon! :)

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Danmaku Unlimited 2
notes.notes:
Danmaku Unlimited 2 is Now Available on Steam and is 20% off to celebrate!

Danmaku Unlimited 2 is an indie labor of love to bring classic Japanese vertical shooting action to modern HD systems. Inspired by Japanese doujin shooters and being authentic to a fault, the game features epic stages filled with beautiful but deadly bullet patterns, nail-bitingly difficult boss fights and seriously rocking soundtracks!
